Advocate 
(imidacloprid/moxidectin) 
13-15 July 2021 Section 4.6 of SPC for Advocate spot-on solution for dogs: 
Vomiting can occur on rare occasions. Use of the product may result in transient 
pruritus in dogs. Vomiting can occur on rare occasions. Transient local skin sensitivity 
reactions including increased itching, hair loss, greasy fur and redness at application site 
have been reported in very rare cases in spontaneous (pharmacovigilance) reports. These 
signs disappear without further treatment. If the animal licks the application site after 
treatment, nNeurological signs, (most of which are transient) such as ataxia and 
muscle tremor (most of which are transient) may be observed in very rare cases
